check(
    "num_islands(3x3 grid)",
    lambda: num_islands([["1", "1", "0"], ["1", "1", "0"], ["0", "0", "1"]]),
    2,
)
check("num_islands(empty grid)", lambda: num_islands([]), 0)
check("num_islands(example 1, rows as strings)", lambda: num_islands(["11000", "11000", "00100", "00011"]), 3)
check("num_islands(example 2, one ring-shaped island)", lambda: num_islands(["111", "010", "111"]), 1)
check("num_islands(all water)", lambda: num_islands([["0", "0"], ["0", "0"]]), 0)
check("num_islands(single land cell)", lambda: num_islands([["1"]]), 1)
check("num_islands(diagonal cells are separate islands)", lambda: num_islands(["101", "010", "101"]), 5)
check("num_islands(spiral is one island)", lambda: num_islands(["11111", "00001", "11101", "10001", "11111"]), 1)
check("num_islands(single row)", lambda: num_islands(["10101"]), 3)

check("can_finish(2, [[1, 0]])", lambda: can_finish(2, [[1, 0]]), True)
check("can_finish(2, [[1, 0], [0, 1]])", lambda: can_finish(2, [[1, 0], [0, 1]]), False)
check("can_finish(no prerequisites)", lambda: can_finish(3, []), True)
check("can_finish(self-loop is a cycle)", lambda: can_finish(1, [[0, 0]]), False)
check("can_finish(three-course cycle)", lambda: can_finish(3, [[0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 0]]), False)
check("can_finish(diamond: shared prerequisite is not a cycle)", lambda: can_finish(4, [[1, 0], [2, 0], [3, 1], [3, 2]]), True)
check("can_finish(cycle in one disconnected part)", lambda: can_finish(5, [[1, 0], [3, 2], [2, 3]]), False)
check("can_finish(duplicate prerequisite pair)", lambda: can_finish(2, [[1, 0], [1, 0]]), True)
check("can_finish(long chain)", lambda: can_finish(5, [[1, 0], [2, 1], [3, 2], [4, 3]]), True)

check("oranges_rotting([[2,1,1],[1,1,0],[0,1,1]])", lambda: oranges_rotting([[2, 1, 1], [1, 1, 0], [0, 1, 1]]), 4)
check("oranges_rotting([[2,1,1],[0,1,1],[1,0,1]])", lambda: oranges_rotting([[2, 1, 1], [0, 1, 1], [1, 0, 1]]), -1)
check("oranges_rotting([[0]])", lambda: oranges_rotting([[0]]), 0)
check("oranges_rotting(fresh orange but nothing rotten)", lambda: oranges_rotting([[1]]), -1)
check("oranges_rotting(all rotten already)", lambda: oranges_rotting([[2, 2]]), 0)
check("oranges_rotting(no fresh oranges, some empty cells)", lambda: oranges_rotting([[0, 2]]), 0)
check("oranges_rotting(two sources rot in parallel)", lambda: oranges_rotting([[2, 1, 1, 1, 2]]), 2)
check("oranges_rotting(fresh orange cut off by an empty cell)", lambda: oranges_rotting([[2, 0, 1]]), -1)
check("oranges_rotting(single column)", lambda: oranges_rotting([[2], [1], [1]]), 2)

check(
    "ladder_length('hit', 'cog', ...) is 5",
    lambda: ladder_length("hit", "cog", ["hot", "dot", "dog", "lot", "log", "cog"]),
    5,
)
check(
    "ladder_length with no path is 0",
    lambda: ladder_length("hit", "cog", ["hot", "dot", "dog", "lot", "log"]),
    0,
)
check("ladder_length(end word not in the list)", lambda: ladder_length("hit", "cog", ["hot"]), 0)
check("ladder_length(one change)", lambda: ladder_length("hot", "dot", ["dot"]), 2)
check("ladder_length(begin word also in the list)", lambda: ladder_length("hot", "dog", ["hot", "dot", "dog"]), 3)
check("ladder_length(single letters)", lambda: ladder_length("a", "c", ["a", "b", "c"]), 2)
check("ladder_length(empty word list)", lambda: ladder_length("hit", "cog", []), 0)
check("ladder_length(picks the shorter of two paths)", lambda: ladder_length("hit", "cog", ["hot", "dot", "dog", "cog", "hog"]), 4)

check("count_components(5, [[0,1],[1,2],[3,4]])", lambda: count_components(5, [[0, 1], [1, 2], [3, 4]]), 2)
check("count_components(5, a chain)", lambda: count_components(5, [[0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 4]]), 1)
check("count_components(no edges)", lambda: count_components(3, []), 3)
check("count_components(single node)", lambda: count_components(1, []), 1)
check("count_components(zero nodes)", lambda: count_components(0, []), 0)
check("count_components(cycle is one component)", lambda: count_components(3, [[0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 0]]), 1)
check("count_components(duplicate edge in both directions)", lambda: count_components(3, [[0, 1], [1, 0]]), 2)
check("count_components(self-loop)", lambda: count_components(2, [[0, 0]]), 2)
check("count_components(a later edge joins two groups)", lambda: count_components(6, [[0, 1], [2, 3], [1, 2], [4, 5]]), 2)
